issues.problem: close value 私も大好きなんです / 'I love it too' presupposes the listener already loves an item they have not tried yet (hat, chair, pen), which reads oddly in many combinations
issues.action: replaced with とても人気があるんですよ。 / It's very popular.

issues.problem: period values 今月 and この前 are vague recent-time words that do not clearly rule out the distractor たところ, so たところ was not plainly wrong in every combination
issues.action: replaced with 去年 / last year and 半年前に / six months ago, which allow only たばかり
